en.headline: Customs seizes 23.5kg of drugs from two passengers at airport
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs arrested a Japanese man and a British man after finding suspected cocaine and ketamine worth about HK$11 million in their baggage on Sunday; both face court on Tuesday.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming air passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday, seizing about 7.5 kilograms of suspected cocaine, about 16 kilograms of suspected ketamine, 52 sticks of duty-not-paid cigarettes, one suspected alternative smoking product and four boxes of suspected Part 1 poisons, with a total estimated market value of about HK$11 million. Two men were arrested.

In the first case, a 48-year-old Japanese male passenger arrived from Bangkok. Officers found the suspected cocaine in his check-in baggage and the cigarettes in his carry-on bag. He has been charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug, possession of dutiable goods and failing to declare dutiable goods.

In the second case, a 34-year-old British male passenger arrived from London. Officers found the suspected ketamine in his check-in baggage and the alternative smoking product and poisons in his carry-on bag. He has been charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug, importing an alternative smoking product and possession of Part 1 poison. Both cases will be heard at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday.

Customs said it would continue risk-based enforcement against transnational drug trafficking and reminded the public not to carry controlled items for others. Trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗販毒案 檢約23.5公斤毒品拘兩男
zh.dek: 海關周日在香港國際機場檢獲約7.5公斤懷疑可卡因及約16公斤懷疑氯胺酮等，市值約1,100萬元，拘捕一名日本籍及一名英國籍男子，兩人周二提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，昨日（九月六日）在香港國際機場偵破兩宗涉及航空入境旅客的販毒案件，共檢獲約七點五公斤懷疑可卡因、約十六公斤懷疑氯胺酮、五十二支未完稅香煙、一件懷疑另類吸煙產品及四盒懷疑第一部毒藥，市值共約一千一百萬元，並拘捕兩名男子。
首宗案件中，一名四十八歲日本籍男旅客由泰國曼谷飛抵本港。海關人員在其寄艙行李內發現約七點五公斤懷疑可卡因，並在其隨身行李內發現五十二支未完稅香煙，遂把他拘捕。他被控一項販運危險藥物罪、一項管有應課稅品罪及一項未有向海關人員申報管有應課稅品罪。
第二宗案件中，一名三十四歲英國籍男旅客由英國倫敦飛抵本港。海關人員在其寄艙行李內發現約十六公斤懷疑氯胺酮，並在其隨身行李內發現一件懷疑另類吸煙產品及四盒懷疑第一部毒藥。他被控一項販運危險藥物罪、一項進口另類吸煙產品罪及一項管有第一部毒藥罪。兩宗案件將於明日（九月八日）在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續加強打擊跨境販毒活動，並呼籲市民切勿接受他人委託運送受管制物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款五百萬元及終身監禁。
